turn: turns 50 to 300 of each run; the seat's share at turns 100, 150, 200, 250 and 300
source: as p6_arms: the power of each living player each turn (telemetry p records); a turn counts as a hegemon turn when the strongest player holds more than 110 per mille of the living players' power (AI_BALANCE_SHARE, here over all living players rather than those one team has met); the seat's share of that power, per mille, median over the runs
sql: select arm, count(*) run_turns, sum((top_power*1000>110*total_power and top_id=12)::int) seat_hegemon_turns, sum((top_power*1000>110*total_power and top_id<>12)::int) ai_hegemon_turns, median(case when turn=100 then 1000.0*seat_power/total_power end) seat_share_100, median(case when turn=150 then 1000.0*seat_power/total_power end) seat_share_150, median(case when turn=200 then 1000.0*seat_power/total_power end) seat_share_200, median(case when turn=250 then 1000.0*seat_power/total_power end) seat_share_250, median(case when turn=300 then 1000.0*seat_power/total_power end) seat_share_300 from turns where turn>=50 group by arm order by arm

who: every declaration of war in the P6 runs, per arm
source: as p6_arms: the telemetry's war events (declaring team, target, both teams' power, the declarer's war plan: 4 limited, 5 total, 6 dogpile); declarations on a stronger target; on the seat; the median turn of the declarations on the seat
sql: select arm, count(*) declarations, sum((on_power>by_power)::int) on_stronger_target, sum((plan=6)::int) dogpile, sum((on_team=12)::int) on_seat, sum((on_team=12 and plan=6)::int) dogpile_on_seat, median(case when on_team=12 then turn end) median_turn_on_seat from wars group by arm order by arm
